fixtures.name: multi-faction + three unit races
fixtures.description: Owners 1-4 receive boosted units and direct Simulation.dispatch orders while paused; verifies owner-specific textures and all three unit sheets are visible. Not a natural match.

fixtures.name: capture texture switch
fixtures.description: A single colony is boosted and dispatched by the test into a neutral nest; the capture itself resolves normally, but the setup is synthetic. Not a natural clear.

fixtures.name: extreme number plate
fixtures.description: Display-only units injection (up to 1e12) on one colony to verify the number shrinks inside its plate. Not a gameplay/balance check.

fixtures.name: victory/defeat result screens
fixtures.description: Ownership is forced through the test hook; verifies result UI and labels only, not a natural completion.
